usage: 獨立屋 (detached house) functions as a noun in a sentence, referring to a type of housing.
It can be used as the subject or object in a sentence, for example: '我想買獨立屋' (I want to buy a detached house).
獨立屋 can be modified by adjectives to describe features, such as '大嘅獨立屋' (big detached house).
It is often contrasted with other housing types like apartments or flats in conversations.
When talking about location or possession, 獨立屋 is combined with prepositions or possessive markers, e.g. '我屋企有一間獨立屋' (My family has a detached house).
